title: The Dolphin's universal Time AI: one Switchback drive for I1-I4, grown from all four genomes - with the AI nose lead ON
goal: The lead-on twin of switchback-dolphin-time: the same search, the same seeds and genomes, with the pilot-side AI nose lead switched on in the model (nose_lead 2.5; Tools/Build/ai_nose_lead.py, the model of AIPilot.NoseLeadGain from PR #1786, which the game ships at 0). the Switchback harness flies the fleet nose lag (Sim.cs), so only the lead is added. Garrett's plan (REGATTA_BALANCE_PLAN.md, the direction since 2026-11-06) judges every hull and every course on AIs that do not overshoot ring mouths, so each hull's drive is searched again with the lead on and compared with its lead-off twin on the same courses: the lead-on winner is the drive proposed for the day Yash turns the switch on. Run by hand until Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py, two independent restarts (labels B, C). Parent goal: The Dolphin's universal Time AI (Docs/AI_SYSTEM/AI_PLAN.md step time-arcade): ONE Switchback (Blast Run) charge drive that races all four intensities well, instead of a file per intensity. Its first generation is the four drives the game ships (the mode-wide DolphinAIBoostPolicy_Switchback and the I1, I2 and I4 files the AI learning sweep learned from Yash's races) and mutations of each; the loss is the four intensities' scores together (mean + 0.5 x the worst), raced on the Blast Run simulator at every difficulty level (one drive serves them all; each level flies its own nose-lag row). Measured 2026-11-02, 4 courses an intensity x 4 levels: mode-wide 1.744, I1 file 1.759, I2 file 1.744 (it is the mode-wide drive), I4 file 1.550 (the best all-rounder), what the game flies today (each intensity's own file, I3 the mode-wide) 1.574. A first local search raced at Hard only reached 1.277 there and won on 8 fresh courses at Hard and Legendary, but lost I4 at Easy, which is why every level is raced. The winner is the Dolphin Regatta is searched against (step time-arena-course).
asked_by: Yash 2026-11-02, the AI owner: "Do the recommended ones" - keep learning from people, the learned files seed one search per vessel; build the Dolphin's Switchback search first. Garrett's plan (AI_PLAN.md rules 2 and 3) sets its shape.
area_owner: Yash (vessel AI, the Switchback AI and its simulator)
promote: Only after Yash turns AIPilot.NoseLeadGain on (PR #1786) and its editor check passes; then as the parent's rule, against the parent's winner raced WITH the lead: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash), any of the core four approving: race the team's best against each shipped genome on 12 FRESH courses per intensity (seedbase 99000) at every difficulty level; keep it only if it finishes as many as the best of them on every intensity and its composite is lower. Then it becomes the mode-wide DolphinAIBoostPolicy_Switchback, written with the learner's writer (Tools/Build/learn_drives_from_flights.py's asset writer), never by hand. The per-intensity files stay until it beats each one on its own intensity; retiring them is Yash's call (AI_PLAN.md decision 1), and the sweep keeps learning them from people as the next round's seeds. The editor check goes in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md (the Switchback soak at I1-I4).
